messages.subject: Re: tons of errors when trying to install deducer and run it, think  it's a java issue
parts:
It appears that you are trying to install all the packages from the
source, but you don't have a C compiler (which rJava requires). also,
you are downloading from the development repository, which might be
unstable. Try installing from one of the CRAN mirrors:
install.packages(c("rJava","JGR","Deducer"))

As you are on a mac, you will need to use Deducer from within JGR

Installation instructions are available:
http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php?n=Main.DownloadingAndInstallingDeducer

Thank you for your interest,
Ian
